name: Agent fleet
description: Scalable catalogue of specialised agents: Nuxiva creates them when needed, attaches tools and widgets, and you see and manage them all, even at millions or billions.
capabilities: 256-shard store with cursor pagination and incremental counters: cost does not grow with the number of agents
Nuxiva creates an agent when needed, avoiding duplicates, and picks tools and widgets that fit the purpose
Attach existing tools and widgets, or a brand-new widget created on the fly
Agent instructions encrypted at rest; active, paused or archived state, also in bulk

settings.NUXIVA_FLEET_AUTO_CREATE: Nuxiva may create agents on its own (1 = yes, 0 = manual only)
